events.description: First coordinated US-Japan currency intervention since 1998. Yen surged from 163.73 to ~156.34. Japan plans to use Fed FIMA repo facility for future interventions to avoid Treasury selling. US sold EUROS to buy yen. Analysts see little hope for sustained rally — fundamentals unchanged.

events.title: US-Japan Joint Yen Intervention — First Since 1998, Yen at 156-157

events.description: NEW ESCALATION: Sberbank executive confirms Russian banks lack ruble liquidity to buy government bonds financing federal deficit. NPLs crossed 10% threshold. Record 620B ruble deposit outflows in July. Central Bank injected 2.3T rubles since Jan. Banks' total CB debt at 6T rubles (.6B). Kremlin-linked think tank warns of systemic crisis by Oct 2026.
events.change_from_last: NEW: Sberbank executive public admission banks can't buy gov't debt. NPLs above 10%. Record deposit outflows. Ukrainian attacks on Russian e-commerce infrastructure threatening bank loan portfolios.
events.title: Russia Systemic Banking Crisis Escalating — Banks Lack Cash for Government Debt
